mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <60% of instances during FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation surge (CPIAUCSL > 2.0) triggers investor concerns about future rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative despite CPIAUCSL crossing above 2.0, or p-value >0.05 in t-test comparing returns during and after the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in consumer demand (GDPC1) and monetary easing (FEDFUNDS decline) creates a synergistic effect, amplifying positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 rising and FEDFUNDS falling for 3 months
failure_condition: The interaction effect fails to predict returns (IC <0.03) or returns are not significantly higher than baseline during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rates below 5% signals labor market recovery, fostering investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing above 5%, or p-value >0.05 in t-test comparing recovery periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals tightening monetary policy, raising discount rates on equities and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns remain non-negative despite FEDFUNDS staying above 4.0%, or IC <0.03 over the 60-day window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in industrial production (INDPRO) and consumer demand (GDPC1) indicates robust economic growth, enhancing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and GDPC1 increase for 2 months
failure_condition: The interaction effect fails to predict returns (IC <0.03) or returns are not significantly higher than baseline during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A tightening labor market (PAYEMS up) combined with falling unemployment (UNRATE down) signals labor scarcity, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls for 3 months
failure_condition: The labor indicators do not move as expected (IC <0.03) or returns are not significantly positive over the 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in industrial production (INDPRO below 95) indicates supply-side weakness, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns remain non-negative despite INDPRO staying below 95, or IC <0.03 over the 60-day window.
